input_contract.authorized_audience: named or typed relying-party scope permitted to receive the projection
input_contract.correlation_controls: declared identifiers, linkability limits and cross-context reuse constraints
input_contract.cryptographic_commitment: binding from disclosed view to the declared source evidence identity or commitment
input_contract.disclosable_projection: explicitly selected view derived from the full evidence object
input_contract.disclosure_policy: versioned rules that determine permitted fields, transformations and omissions
input_contract.evaluation_context: purpose, policy revision and operation context fixed before disclosure evaluation
input_contract.full_evidence_artifact: complete evidence object retained by its declared owner
input_contract.revocation_state: current declared revocation or withdrawal observation for evidence, policy and disclosure authorization
